decisions.product: Authentic 1995 Pinnacle Baseball U.S. product in two physically separate 225-card series. Collector-facing base unified 1–450; 12 cards per hobby/retail pack, 36 per box; jumbo 15 per pack 36 per box.
decisions.independentAudit: Each base number and subject cross-checked BaseballCardPedia's complete 450-item sequence against independent CollectionCount. Nine documented display spelling/name differences normalized, including original Griffey/Ripken Jr. punctuation, Dave/David Weathers, and Mel/Melvin Nieves. Nine physical checklist cards #177–180, 446–450 have deliberately NULL team; do not invent team affiliations.
decisions.rookies: Five true rookie-card badges appear on base cards #167 McKay Christensen, #169 Antone Williamson, #171 Scott Elarton, #174 Mark Johnson and #176 Jayson Peterson. Paul Konerko #170 is not tagged rookie (prior RC exists). BCP notes no notable RC stars, consistent with rookie index.
decisions.baseSubsets: Original base subfamilies are Rookies #131–166 and #406–444, Draft Picks #167–176, Swing Men #276–305, and league/checklists #177–180 and #446–450.
decisions.parallels: Exactly two full #1–450 parallel checklists: Museum Collection Dufex emanating from team logo, and Artist's Proof silver foil/stamp. These are not serial numbered; 1995 Artist's Proof print run was NOT announced. Holographic foil Artist's Proof rare test/possible accidental issue lacks official provenance, so excluded rather than fabricating a 450-card set.
decisions.museumRedemption: Seven distinct cardboard Museum Collection redemption vouchers for #410 Shane Andrews, #413 James Baldwin, #416 Ray Durham, #420 Todd Hollandsworth, #423 Troy Percival, #426 Michael Tucker, #444 Rich Aude. Redeem by Dec 31, 1995; include separately from authentic finished parallels.
decisions.inserts: Nine offerings: ETA '95 6 Series One hobby; Gate Attractions 18 Series Two jumbo; New Blood 9 Series Two hobby/retail; Pinnacle Performers 18 Series One jumbo; Red Hot 25 Series Two hobby/retail; White Hot 25 Series Two hobby Dufex, separately numbered WH1–WH25; Team Pinnacle 9 original double-sided pairings with intentional separate Dufex on front and Dufex on back versions (18 collector variant entries); Team Pinnacle Pin Redemptions 18 Series Two NNO cards; Upstarts 30 Series One hobby/retail.
decisions.pinExchanges: TCDB independently records 18 separate mail-in-only Team Pinnacle Collector Pins Exchange subjects. Model them as a distinct 18-card collectible exchange subset, NOT wax-inserted. NNO redemption and exchange subjects use VCS PIN-01…18 and EX-01…18 virtual inventory identifiers; not misrepresented as printed card numbers.
decisions.promoExclusion: Nine SAMPLE promotional cards (seven base reprints, US22 promo, and unnumbered title card) belong to promotional distribution and are not normal product pack cards. Do not invent their wax odds.

historicalHobbyOdds.seriesOne: Museum Collection 1:4; Artist's Proof 1:36; Team Pinnacle 1:90; ETA '95 1:24 (hobby only); Upstarts 1:8. Pinnacle Performers 1:12 JUMBO only.
historicalHobbyOdds.seriesTwo: Museum Collection 1:4; Artist's Proof 1:36; Red Hot 1:8; White Hot not published; Team Pinnacle Pin redemptions 1:48; New Blood 1:90. Gate Attractions 1:12 JUMBO only.
historicalHobbyOdds.retail: Museum Collection 1:4, Artist's Proof 1:36, Team Pinnacle 1:90 (Series One), Upstarts 1:8 Series One; New Blood 1:90, Pin redemptions 1:48, Red Hot 1:8 Series Two. ETA '95 hobby-exclusive and no White Hot verified retail odds.
historicalHobbyOdds.jumbo: Museum Collection 1:3; Artist's Proof not available; Series One Pinnacle Performers 1:12; Series Two Gate Attractions 1:12 and Pin redemptions 1:36.

decisions.packRestriction: VCS currently cannot model physical Series One vs Series Two or hobby vs retail vs jumbo pools and cannot honor Team Pinnacle Dufex-side variants/unnumbered mail-in exchange gating in a unified pack. Therefore all oddsPerPack intentionally NULL. We do not fabricate a blended pack hit rate. Block public release until series/channel-aware pack collation exists.
decisions.reviewGate: Unreleased pending authentic front/back images, pack/box art, pricing, era-correct metadata and pack series/channel QA. Does not alter existing image URLs, set valuations, or other VCS content.
decisions.teamAudit: All non-checklist cards have verified clubs. Nine authentic base checklist cards deliberately have NULL team, recognized by the importer's checklist exception; the 900 parallel copies inherit the same nine intentional exceptions. Therefore teamData is COMPLETE.

productSets.name: Base Set
